89
母鸡家的房子会咬人
mǔ jī jiā de fáng zi huì yǎo rén
page_text_en:
89
The hen's house bites people
mǔ jī jiā de fáng zi huì yǎo rén
summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示标题“母鸡家的房子会咬人”及页码89。

page_text_ocr_zh:
螃蟹有两只大而有力的螯，不过他只用来保护自己，从来不欺负别人。
那天，天渐渐地黑了下来，螃蟹来到池塘边上看星星，他知道那儿的星星很美丽。
这时，只见青蛙跑过来说：“不好
了，我听见狐狸一边走，一边自言自语，说他要去母鸡家用晚餐！”
“是母鸡请他去用晚餐吗？”螃蟹问道。
page_text_en:
The crab has two big and strong claws, but he only uses them to protect himself and never bullies others.
That day, as the sky gradually grew dark, the crab came to the edge of the pond to watch the stars. He knew the stars there were very beautiful.
At that moment, the frog ran over and said: “Oh no!
I heard the fox walking along, muttering to himself, saying he’s going to have dinner at the hen’s house!”
“Did the hen invite him to dinner?” the crab asked.
summary_zh: 本页描述了螃蟹在池塘边看星星时，青蛙跑来告诉他狐狸自言自语说要去母鸡家用晚餐，螃蟹对此表示疑问。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“不！”青蛙着急地说，“是狐狸要把母鸡全家当晚餐！”
“这只坏狐狸，他在哪儿？”
“他正向母鸡家走去呢！”

螃蟹二话不说，飞快地追到了小路边。
狐狸正一边赶路一边自言自语：
“我要把母鸡全家当晚餐！”
page_text_en:
"No!" the frog said anxiously, "It's the fox who wants to make the whole chicken family his dinner!"
"This bad fox, where is he?"
"He's heading toward the chicken family's house!"

The crab didn't say a word and quickly chased after him to the side of the path.
The fox was hurrying along, muttering to himself:
"I'm going to make the whole chicken family my dinner!"
summary_zh: 青蛙告诉螃蟹狐狸正要去母鸡家吃晚餐，螃蟹立即追了上去，而狐狸一边赶路一边自言自语要吃掉母鸡全家。

page_text_ocr_zh:
螃蟹不认识母鸡的家，没法儿赶去报信。就在这时，只见狐狸的尾巴朝他这儿一甩，螃蟹趁机钳住了狐狸尾巴上的毛。狐狸光顾着赶路，一点也没觉察尾巴上吊着个螃蟹。

狐狸来到母鸡家门口，他说：“我得使劲敲敲母鸡家的门！”

这时，螃蟹早已跳下狐狸的尾巴，来到母鸡家的大门前。狐狸刚一伸手，螃蟹就使劲用大螯钳住他的爪子。
page_text_en:
The crab didn't recognize the hen's house and couldn't go to report the news. Just then, the fox's tail swung toward him, and the crab seized the opportunity to pinch the fur on the fox's tail. The fox was too busy hurrying along and didn't notice the crab dangling from his tail.

The fox arrived at the hen's doorstep and said, "I need to knock hard on the hen's door!"

At that moment, the crab had already jumped off the fox's tail and arrived at the hen's front door. As soon as the fox reached out his paw, the crab grabbed it tightly with his big claws.
summary_zh: 螃蟹趁狐狸赶路时钳住其尾巴，随后跳下并守在母鸡家门前，当狐狸伸手敲门时，螃蟹立即用大螯钳住了他的爪子。

page_text_ocr_zh:
狐狸疼得直哼哼：“好疼，好疼，母鸡家的大门会咬人！”
狐狸离开大门，来到母鸡家窗前，他想撞开窗子进屋。狐狸的爪子刚一搭上窗台，螃蟹就在窗前使劲钳了狐狸一下。
page_text_en:
The fox winced and groaned: "Ouch, ouch, the door at the chicken's house bites people!"
The fox left the door and came to the window of the chicken's house. He tried to crash through the window to get in. As soon as the fox's paw touched the windowsill, the crab clamped down on the fox hard from in front of the window.
summary_zh: 狐狸在母鸡家门前被门咬伤，他来到窗前试图撞窗进屋，但刚搭上窗台就被守在窗前的螃蟹钳住。

page_text_ocr_zh:
狐狸疼得直哼哼：“好疼，好疼，母鸡家的窗子会咬人！”

狐狸使劲爬上母鸡家的房顶，想从烟囱爬进屋子。

狐狸刚一伸脑袋，早在那儿等候的螃蟹，使劲钳住狐狸的鼻子。

狐狸疼得直掉眼泪：“好疼，好疼，母鸡家的烟囱会咬人！”
page_text_en:
The fox groaned in pain: "Ouch, ouch, the window at the hen's house bites people!"

The fox struggled to climb onto the roof of the hen's house, trying to crawl in through the chimney.

As soon as the fox stuck out his head, the crab waiting there clamped down hard on the fox's nose.

The fox cried out in pain, tears streaming down: "Ouch, ouch, the chimney at the hen's house bites people!"
summary_zh: 狐狸试图从烟囱进入母鸡家，但被守候在窗前的螃蟹钳住鼻子，疼痛难忍，误以为是烟囱在咬人。

page_text_ocr_zh:
狐狸赶忙跳下房顶撒腿逃走，他一边跑一边还叫着：“好疼，好疼，母鸡家的房子会咬人！”
螃蟹乐得舞起他的两只大螯。
这时，爱看星星的螃蟹发现，母鸡家房顶上的星星是那么漂亮……
page_text_en:
The fox hurriedly jumped off the roof and ran away, shouting as he ran: "Ouch, ouch, the hen's house bites people!"
The crab happily danced with his two big claws.
At this moment, the star-loving crab noticed that the stars on the roof of the hen's house were so beautiful...
summary_zh: 狐狸被母鸡家的房子咬伤后仓皇逃走，螃蟹则高兴地舞动大螯，并发现母鸡家房顶上的星星非常漂亮。
